title: Nautilus Smoke Tests
content:
Nautilus Smoke Tests The package smoke tests verify contract validation, deterministic execution evidence, explicit degraded states, proofpack samples, replay samples, and example fixture sync. Smoke commands npm run nautilus:golden-path
npm run nautilus:replay-smoke
npm run nautilus:proofpack-smoke
npm run nautilus:runtime-health-smoke
npm run nautilus:examples
npm run nautilus:verify
Expected behavior nautilus:golden-path emits a completed deterministic scenario. nautilus:replay-smoke emits a read-only replay report. nautilus:proofpack-smoke emits a partial proofpack by default; use npx tsx scripts/nautilus/proofpack-smoke.ts complete for the complete fixture. nautilus:runtime-health-smoke emits an explicit degraded runtime-health sample. nautilus:examples verifies every example README, command, and expected output. nautilus:verify runs the package verification chain
summary: The package smoke tests verify contract validation, deterministic execution evidence, explicit degraded states, proofpack samples, replay samples, and example fixture sync.
